referenceSources.description:
A striking blue Porsche 934 Turbo, prepared by Kremer Racing, stands on display at an indoor automotive exhibition. The car’s wide fenders, gold mesh wheels wrapped in Goodyear Eagle tires, and large rear wing emphasize its racing pedigree. Spectators mill around in the background, with banners and booths suggesting a motorsport or classic car show setting.

Photographed on February 4, 2012, at 22:45 with a digital still camera (7.4 mm lens, f/2.8, 1/20 sec, ISO 800), the image captures the glossy finish and aerodynamic details under bright exhibition lighting. The file is 1600 × 1200 pixels and licensed on Wikimedia Commons under an attribution-required license.
